name: kestrix
description: The Kestrix Claude Code plugin: local, deterministic security checks on the code Claude writes.

plugins.name: kestrix
plugins.description: Scans every file Claude writes with the local kestrix-scan scanner and has Claude fix the findings, plus secure-review skills and /kestrix:scan, /kestrix:fix and /kestrix:review. Offline; hooks open no network connections.
